entries.text: BenchBox now ships the official TPC-DI tools archive (DIGen and PDGF) unmodified, with the TPC and PDGF licence texts and a sourcing file, and unpacks it into its cache directory on first use after verifying its SHA-256.
details: PDGF is licensed by bankmark for generating TPC-DI data for internal, academic and research purposes only; read tpc-di/tools/PDGF-LICENSE.txt in the package before generating data.
The package licence metadata stays MIT.
